Are you an ambitious researcher with a background in neuroscience or biomolecular science? As a PhD _tudent in our team, you will investigate how cell-type vulnerability or resilience impact neurodegeneration in the human brain using innovative proteomics other -omics techniques. Frontotemporal dementia (FTD) encompasses a group of neurodegenerative diseases that progressively affect behavior, movement, personality and/or language. We aim to identify the molecular and cellular causes of FTD that trigger its onset and early progression with the aim to design evidence-based treatment. We are looking for a highly motivated researcher to join our team. You will design and execute proteomics studies on human brain tissue of sporadic patients and human iPSC-derived neurons. The aim is to understand the molecular and cellular dysfunctions that lead to cell-type-specific vulnerability that may be causative to FTD through highly innovative single-cell and spatial (prote)-omics technologies. Would you like to know more about the different phases within the PhD trajectory? You can read more about this on this page. As a member of our team, you will: design and execute proteomics studies to identify cell-type specific vulnerability; perform experiments in human postmortem FTD brain tissue and patient iPSC-derived neuronal cell cultures; aid in data analysis and integration of -omics datasets to characterize cell-specific functional dysregulation and cellular crosstalk; contribute to scientific reporting, publications, and regulatory-ready data packages; supervise undergraduate _tudents; report on your findings in regular work meetings, conferences, and scientific publications in reputable journals. This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to translational neuroscience in a dynamic team of proteomic and neuroscience researchers in the search for fun_amental insights with real-world therapeutic impact. You have: a master's degree in neuroscience, biomolecularscience, or biochemistry; proven expertise and skills with molecular and cellular work as part of an internship; experience with programming and data analysis (Python, R). Expertise with omics datasets is a strong advantage; strong written and verbal communication skills in English. We are looking for the following personality traits: excellent organisational and management skills; working diligently and with high accuracy; a team player who enjoys collaborating in an interdisciplinary environment; a creative and independent thinker who takes initiative. You will be employed by Amsterdam UMC Research BV. A contract for 12 months, with the intention to extend for a total of four years. The Guideline PhD contract applies to this vacancy. Classification in salary scale OIO: € 3.217 to € 4.077 gross for full-time employment (depending on experience). In addition to a good basic salary, we offer 8.3% end-of-year bonus. Calculate your net salary here. Holiday hours: 194.4 per year for full time and a possibility to save additional hours. 100% reimbursement for public transport travel costs. If you travel by foot, bicycle, or car, a mileage allowance of €0.21 per km applies (up to a maximum of 40 km one way by car). Do you prefer walking or cycling? Take advantage of our good bike scheme. Pension accrual with BeFrank, a modern, comprehensible and fairly priced pension. Watch this video with more information about joining Amsterdam UMC Research BV. The project is part of the larger Adore initiative, which aims to bring together cancer and neuroscience expertise and drive biomedical breakthroughs in both fields. This project is a clear example of that ambition, and you will work closely with researchers from both the Cancer Center Amsterdam, Center for Neurogenomics & Cognitive Research at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam and the Alzheimer Center Amsterdam UMC. The position is embedded in the single-cell proteomics unit, with new labs in the new RDC Adore building, and cell

As a Mechanical Maintenance Technician, your responsibilities include: Performing preventive maintenance on production machinery, conveyors, packaging lines, and utilities. Inspecting critical machine components such as bearings, chains, sensors, and seals. Diagnosing and repairing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and basic hydraulic faults. Testing and releasing equipment after repairs. Carrying out inspections and condition monitoring to identify wear, leaks, unusual noises, and performance issues. Recording maintenance activities and findings in the CMMS. Installing, dismantling, and modifying machine components during maintenance and production changeovers. Assisting with technical improvements and production line optimizations. Working according to HACCP food safety and hygiene standards. Applying Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) procedures to ensure safe maintenance activities. Collaborating closely with operators, engineers, planners, and fellow maintenance technicians. Supporting continuous improvement initiatives such as 5S, TPM, root cause analysis, and standardization projects. Managing spare parts responsibly and advising on critical stock levels. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive salary based on your experience. A year-end bonus. 25 vacation days. Travel expense reimbursement. An excellent pension scheme. Opportunities for training and professional development. A stable, long-term position within a growing international organization. Functie-eisen You are a proactive technician who enjoys working in a team and takes ownership of technical challenges. You work safely, accurately, and have a strong focus on quality. You also have: An MBO Level 3 or 4 diploma (or international equivalent) in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Automation, Installation Technology, or a related technical discipline. Experience in industrial maintenance within a production or manufacturing environment. Knowledge of mechanical drives, bearings,chains, gears, pneumatics, and basic hydraulics. Basic understanding of PLC inputs and outputs (programming experience is not required). Experience working with motors, sensors, frequency drives, and conveyor systems. Experience using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) is an advantage. A valid VCA certificate, LOTO training, and NEN 3140 certification are beneficial, or willingness to obtain them. Good communication skills in English. Dutch is an advantage but not required. Hier kom je te werken As a Mechanical Maintenance Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring our production and packaging lines operate safely, efficiently, and reliably. You will carry out preventive maintenance, resolve mechanical breakdowns, and contribute to continuous improvements while maintaining the highest food safety and hygiene standards.
